scope: Grade distribution and repeatability on synthetic Goals; no human calibration

Preserve the stored Goal due date when an edit changes only its priority
Add CSV export for the filtered expense report
Remember the most recently selected workspace tab and restore it after restarting the application
Let a user search and select a Task using only the keyboard in the existing Goal editor
Make same-name credential renewal and expired game-controller recovery atomic across HTTP and MCP requests
Reject unknown fields in a stored Goal and show the resulting unavailable state consistently in the server, dashboard and TUI
Expose a Keeper tool that reads its own current Candle balance and purchased items from the existing ledger
Provide a portrait item catalog with previews for every listed item and restore the default appearance when the preview is cleared
Add profile image upload with file validation, stored resized images, authenticated retrieval and an account-settings preview
Show each Goal verification request and result in a timeline with its actual actor and evidence in both the dashboard and TUI
Deliver a scheduled daily workspace report with persisted schedules, a durable delivery outbox, retry after restart and operator controls
Implement an append-only account ledger with atomic purchases, balances, item ownership, replay after restart and an audit view
Deliver the complete Candle purchase-and-equip workflow through Keeper tools, authenticated APIs, dashboard and TUI portraits
Allow two workspace instances to exchange Board posts, comments and reactions with authenticated peers, durable reconciliation and duplicate suppression
